newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Texas Instruments Inc.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Texas Instruments Inc.

text.p: -- Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said it upgraded Texas Instruments Inc to accumulate from hold.
-- cited the company's heightened focus on semiconductors, which are at the early stage of cyclical recovery, and its departure from several equipment businesses.
-- expect semiconductor sales and royalties will account for 80 percent of sales and almost all of the 1997 operating profits.
-- said raised the 1997 earnings estimate to $3.70 a share from $2.95 a share, assuming for extraordinary charges.
-- set a price target of $78 a share.
